facts.statement: The ERASE study is a randomized controlled trial conducted at multiple sites.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: 660 patients from seven Chinese stroke centers will be split evenly between a robotic-assisted group and a control group.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Participants in both groups will have their arteries accessed using the Seldinger technique.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The study uses a design where the doctors know which treatment is given, but the people reviewing the images do not.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The main measure of success is the clinical success rate of the procedure.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The main safety measure is the rate of complications, serious adverse events, and device malfunctions.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Secondary measures include procedural time, radiation dose, and the volume of contrast agent used.
facts.subject: humans
